blurb: The common envelope with the tabulated hydrogen and helium equation of state. A red giant’s envelope is between 10⁴ and a few 10⁵ K, where hydrogen and helium are partly ionized: the energy their recombination gives back as the envelope expands is a large part of what binds it, and here it is part of the gas’s energy. Gas alone, without the radiation term. In the frame of the center of mass.
